packageRules.description: 8.0.x: nothing but confluent-common-bom. pint merges its update up to 8.1.x-8.4.x, so the other 8.x branches need no Renovate PRs. The BOM is excluded here rather than re-enabled below: this disable applies per dependency, before update types are known, so a later rule with matchUpdateTypes cannot turn it back on.
confluent-common-bom on master: major, minor and patch updates.
confluent-common-bom on 8.0.x: split patch from minor. By default Renovate merges them into one update to the newest minor, which the rule below disables, so a newer minor would hide every patch.
confluent-common-bom on 8.0.x: no major or minor updates, so the 8.x branches stay on the BOM line for CP 8.x (1.0.x) and never jump to master's line.
confluent-common-bom on every base branch: its own group, so it gets a separate PR instead of joining the global "minor+patch dependencies" group.
